newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT DoCoMo to experiment with CDMA technology.
newsitem.headline: NTT DoCoMo to experiment with CDMA technology.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp's cellular phone unit, the NTT DoCoMo group, said on Thursday it would experiment with wide-band code division multiple-access (CDMA) mobile phone technology.
The CDMA standard is a next-generation digital cellular phone tehnology which is one of a number of competing technologies developed to expand wireless phone networks and enhance call quality.

NTT DoCoMo said it would procure equipment for the CDMA experiment from from 12 companies including Fujitsu Ltd , NEC Corp, Matsushita Communication Industrial Co Ltd, Mitsubishi Electric Corp and Motorola Inc.
NTT DoCoMo has more than half the Japanese cell phone market.
